data.explanation: This is a private invoice (Privatrechnung) from your physiotherapy practice for treatments you received. You need to pay €301.30 by bank transfer using the invoice number PB-0525-117 as the payment reference, by the deadline shown (30 days from the invoice date). The invoice is exempt from VAT under §4 No. 14 UStG (medical services). The letter does not state what happens if you miss the deadline, but late payment could lead to a reminder. Keep this invoice, as private medical costs like physiotherapy can sometimes be claimed as extraordinary burdens (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) on your tax return.
data.tax_note: Private medical expenses such as physiotherapy, if not reimbursed by insurance, can potentially be claimed as extraordinary burdens (außergewöhnliche Belastungen) in the German tax return; keep this invoice as a receipt.
